finalText:
Build is clean. The error was in `src/core/settings.js` line 17 — it referenced an undefined variable `retries`. Fixed it by adding `maxRetries: 3` to the DEFAULTS object and changing the reference to `env.maxRetries || DEFAULTS.maxRetries` to match the pattern used for other config values.

Three warnings remain (deprecated crypto API, unused export, circular import), but those aren't blocking the build.
